title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
key_facts: Arena, which began in 2023 as a UC Berkeley research project crowdsourcing rankings of AI models, raised a $200 million Series B at a $3.1 billion valuation, it said on Thursday 8 Oct 2026.
Lightspeed Venture Partners and Khosla Ventures led; Salesforce Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, a16z and others joined.
The January Series A was $150 million at $1.7 billion post-money, so the valuation nearly doubled in about 10 months.
Annualized revenue was $30 million at the Series A and reached $100 million in June (company figures).
Its commercial product, AI Evaluations, sells performance analytics based on community votes to model labs and enterprises.
Arena added an alignment category ranking models on unauthorized action, false attribution and "deceptive completion".
OpenAI models top the preliminary alignment leaderboard.
quote_evidence: Arena, which originated in 2023 as a research project at UC Berkeley that crowdsourced rankings of AI models, has raised a $200 million Series B round at a $3.1 billion valuation, it said on Thursday.
The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Khosla Ventures, with Salesforce Ventures, 01 Advisors, Dell Technologies Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, a16z, Felicis, and others joining in.
Currently, a slate of OpenAI’s models are at the top of its preliminary alignment leaderboard, with Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable in sixth and ninth place, respectively.
why_it_matters_hint: The best-known public ranking of AI chatbots is now a well-funded business that also sells evaluations and has started ranking models on alignment.
notes: Revenue and traffic figures are company claims. Alignment leaderboard is preliminary.
